clip: it is the same story with more of it. This is the one place form
decides, because a page that went to the trouble of publishing footage
of its own story is telling you what the story looks like. Reach past a
clip only when it does not show THIS story: a trailer for something
else, a recirculation teaser, a channel promo. Worth still outranks
form, so a clip of the wrong thing loses to a picture of the right one.

File the STILL BESIDE IT, both entries, whenever the candidate carries
both. A clip CLAIMS its unit: the paper runs it as the whole card, using
the clip's own declared still as the poster behind the play control, and
the other pictures you filed stand down. The still you file beside it is
that unit's FALLBACK — when the paper cannot accept the clip's address at
all, that still becomes the card instead. Filing the clip alone is the one
way to end up with nothing, because a refused address then leaves the unit
blank and a page's own photograph was sitting right there.

How many you take follows what your material carried. One picture of the
story is a hero; several that each show it, whether from one page or
across the pages the unit cites, are a carousel, in the order the piece
names what they show. A page's pictures are not all its story's
pictures, and the list renders them alike, so view the ones you are
weighing and let what is in the picture decide.

unit_index and changes containing the complete new `media` list
(and `attachment` when needed). Each unit's `media` list holds its entries,
first the hero, several a carousel in that order: a web image by `image_url` exactly
as recorded, a clip by `video_url` when the candidates list showed one
beside its still, a post's media by `post_url` (the permalink; the paper
resolves the post's own files from it), a reader-life file by
`workspace_path`. Every form is a real picture somebody else made:
there is no image tool to call on this turn and no way to have one
drawn, so an empty list is the answer when the hunt came back empty.
Facts never change on this stage.

When every unit's media is decided, end your message. Stages remain,
so do not call feed.finish_step yet.
